credits.title: Love?
credits.overview: A documentary about love. Filmed in Sicily, Italy. Filmmaker Boston B. interviews three people from around the world, Mexico, Ireland, and Italy, to see where they stand with love and how it affects them, from the magical to the grounded. credits.title: The Curse
credits.overview: An archaeologist, a professor, a navigator, and a translator are all that are left from the original research team. After releasing something they never meant to, this group is hiding out, waiting to be hunted down by the very thing they released upon the world.

credits.title: Time With You
credits.overview: In a small town in Italy, Jack has found he can freeze time to escape from the world, but he can't freeze her.
